meta.scope: Power 4 plus Notre Dame football head coaches, 2026 season
meta.notes: Maps a cited contract step-down onto remaining 2026 games. Public-school buyouts prefer the employment agreement, amendment, or board packet; articles are the fallback only when no current file is on the desk. The buyout in force after a kickoff is the step that covers the next calendar day — not a renegotiation after each Saturday. We do not invent Saturday stairs or mint remaining-pay dollars from a bare percent clause. Paid buyouts (already-owed money after a firing) live on the tape/layers desk, not here.
